entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?

Oh, hi. I... I'm not sure if I'm doing this right. I have this jersey I got for Christmas, and it's... well, it's just sitting here. I tried to look online, but it's all so complicated. I just don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Just so I'm clear, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A preference? I guess so. It's the wrong size. I tried it on once and it's just... way too tight. I was hoping to exchange it, but the website had all these forms and dates... I got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let's get this sorted out for you. It sounds like you just need to exchange it for a different size. Let me just pull up our policy. Can I get your order number?
Oh, let me see... yes, it's VF-8675309.
Thank you. I see the order here. It was delivered 29 days ago. Let me just check our current policy for apparel.
Okay, great news. For a standard item like a jersey, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for the correct size or a full refund if you prefer.
Oh, really? That's it? That's such a relief. I thought I had missed the deadline. I would love to do an exchange for one size up.

Not a problem at all. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box with the jersey inside, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size immediately. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds perfect. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
